svg.title: Large-ship routes in Alaska run the Inside Passage, Cook Inlet, Prince William Sound, and Unimak Pass; satellite data add the great-circle lanes far offshore

cc:Work.dc:title: Large-ship routes in Alaska run the Inside Passage, Cook Inlet, Prince William Sound, and Unimak Pass; satellite data add the great-circle lanes far offshore
cc:Work.dc:description: Map of Alaska. Blue route cells follow the Inside Passage in Southeast Alaska, Cook Inlet to Anchorage, Prince William Sound to Valdez, and Unimak Pass near Dutch Harbor; purple satellite-AIS hexagons add a wide band of lanes along and south of the Aleutians and patches in the Bering Sea.
